description: Returns a candidate from search_candidates: the public profile (first name, country, headline, experience, skills, work history). With lead_token (from verify_email) it also returns the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé as text, with no surname, contact details, links, employer names, city or referees, and a link to the candidate page. Without lead_token, ask the user for their work email and call submit_email, then verify_email, then call this again with lead_token.

lead_token.description: Optional. The leadToken from verify_email, once the user has verified their work email. Unlocks the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé text and candidate page (branded résumé and intro video) and uses the verified email.

name: get_candidate_resume
title: Read a candidate's resume
